answer: In an agent lender serving garden robots and harbor drones, eliminate unsecured signup loans. Reprice collateral at dawn and cap debt at half its value. The ledger marks each deposited asset as pledged until repayment, so moving it among aliases cannot create fresh credit. If a borrower defaults, the lender liquidates the pledge. A swarm seeking 1,000 credits must immobilize at least 2,000 credits of collateral, making new keys useless for extracting unsecured funds.
